emma.title: EMMA
emma.metadata.description: Sign in to EMMA, the Editor for Managing Multiphase Allowlists, to build distribution plans with airdrops, allowlists and public minting.
emma.plans.metadata.description: Create and manage multiphase distribution plans with airdrops, allowlists and public minting.
emma.plan.metadata.description: Edit a multiphase distribution plan with airdrop, allowlist and public minting phases.
emma.connectDescription: Connect with an address from within your consolidated account to proceed, so that we can verify your TDH to grant you access. No special delegation is required. Please don't connect your vault.
emma.noFee: No gas is needed to sign in, and there is no cost or fee to use the tool.
emma.plansDescription: The Seize distribution plan tool allows you to build a distribution plan for your mint that includes airdrops, allowlists and public minting in one or more phases.
emma.introduction: Meet EMMA - The Editor for Managing Multiphase Allowlists: The first reference implementation of Janus.
emma.history: The Memes and the Allowlist Research Institute have built what may be the world's deepest expertise in complex allowlist management across 150+ NFT drops (and counting). These efforts lead to the creation of {janus}, a domain-specific language for deeply customized allowlist management.
emma.community: EMMA was created as the internal team tool so that The Memes team can smoothly manage multiple complex weekly NFT drops. We are making this tool available for any member of The Memes community who wants to use it for their own drops.
emma.resources: Please note: Since the tool can use significant computational resources for complex allowlists, we have some mild anti-spam measures currently in place to protect system performance. Specifically, we use our community's "proof of humanity" or anti-Sybil measure (TDH) as a lightweight rate-limiter on allowlist creation. We will reevaluate and increase or decrease the limits over time. As always, we reserve the right to change access to this free tool, including sunsetting it altogether.
emma.limited: Users with TDH < 25,000 (but at least 1) will be limited to 3 allowlists per day.
emma.unlimited: Users with TDH > 25,000 can create unlimited allowlists per day.
emma.review.publishNeedsFinalization: Finish preparing the distribution before publishing
emma.review.name: Name
emma.review.publishNeedsAirdrops: Upload artist or team airdrops first
emma.review.manualHelp: Opens the subscription downloads for each phase. After downloading the lists, use Finalize Distribution. You can choose background preparation until a manual action saves subscriber work.
emma.review.backgroundHelp: Prepares all phases, including Public, and finalizes in the background. Return here to see progress and download the lists.
emma.review.resetHelp: Clears subscriber work and lets you choose either method again. Artist and team airdrop uploads are kept.
emma.review.manualLocked: Manual work is saved. Use Reset Subscriptions to switch to background preparation.
emma.review.manualOpen: Manual controls are open. You can still use Process and Finalize until a manual action saves subscriber work.
